segments.text: Most habits die for one dumb reason: you start way too big.
Atomic Habits' fix is almost embarrassingly simple. The two-minute rule.
Shrink the habit until it takes two minutes. Read one page. Do one push-up. Write one sentence.
It feels pointless — and that's exactly the point. You're not trying to win. You're learning to show up.
Because a habit you do badly still beats the one you skip. Master showing up, then scale.
That's the trick worth stealing. The full verdict's on the channel.
